ceu: ✦ The trine between Mars and Pluto

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Make a family recipe and share it.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Turn off notifications for an hour and notice the calm that follows.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Keep a coin in a special place as a symbol of your prosperity.
